{{
{
  selectedQueryId:
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters &&
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters.selectedQueryId
      ? String(
          appsmith.store.analisisFilters.selectedQueryId
        )
      : "0542957e-d74f-423f-9c8a-ca569d48dda3",

  selectedQueryName:
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters &&
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters.selectedQueryName
      ? String(
          appsmith.store.analisisFilters.selectedQueryName
        )
      : "MVP - Julio Menchaca",

  periodDays:
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters &&
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters.periodDays
      ? Number(
          appsmith.store.analisisFilters.periodDays
        )
      : 30,

  platform:
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters &&
    appsmith.store.analisisFilters.platform
      ? String(
          appsmith.store.analisisFilters.platform
        )
      : "all",

  queries:
    appsmith.store.analisisRuntime &&
    Array.isArray(
      appsmith.store.analisisRuntime.queries
    )
      ? appsmith.store.analisisRuntime.queries
      : [],

  runtime:
    appsmith.store.analisisRuntime || {
      queries: [],
      estado: null,
      palancas: [],
      formatos: [],
      evidencias: [],

      meta: {
        loading: true,
        empty: false,
        error: "",
        generatedAt: null
      }
    },

  state: {
    score: null,
    level: "",
    headline: "",
    explanation: "",
    trendPct: null,
    currentEngagement: null,
    previousEngagement: null
  },

  kpis: {
    posts: null,
    interactions: null,
    comments: null,
    views: null
  },

  drivers: [],
  frictions: [],
  actions: [],
  opportunities: [],
  topPosts: [],
  timeline: [],

  coverage: {
    postsTotal: null,
    postsWithMetrics: null,
    metricsPct: null,
    latestMetricAt: null
  },

  meta: {
    loading: true,
    empty: false,
    error: "",
    generatedAt: null
  }
}
}}
